description.value:
Trigger An ally is targeted by an attack from a tech creature or a creature wielding a weapon with the tech trait.

An angelic messenger swarms the attacking creature with nonsensical data derived from prayers emanating from their tech devices. The target must attempt a Will saving throw. Regardless of the result, the target becomes immune to angelic signal for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to all attack and damage rolls with tech weapons until the end of the turn.

Failure The target takes a –2 status penalty to all attack and damage rolls with tech weapons until the end of the turn.

Critical Failure The target takes a –3 status penalty to all attack and damage rolls with tech weapons until the end of the turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Angelic Signal]
